mapper.select: SELECT e.expense_id, e.user_card_id, uc.card_id, e.merchant_id, e.category_id, m.merchant_code, c.category_code AS category_code, c.parent_category_id AS parent_category_id, pc.category_code AS parent_category_code, e.amount, e.applied_benefit_id, e.discount_amount, e.payment_type, e.is_interest_free, e.payment_status, e.payment_date, b.use_shared_limit, b.exclude_from_performance FROM expense e JOIN user_card uc ON uc.user_card_id = e.user_card_id JOIN category c ON c.category_id = e.category_id LEFT JOIN category pc ON pc.category_id = c.parent_category_id LEFT JOIN merchant m ON m.merchant_id = e.merchant_id LEFT JOIN benefit b ON b.benefit_id = e.applied_benefit_id WHERE e.expense_id = #{expenseId} AND e.member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.update: UPDATE expense SET payment_status = 'CANCELED' WHERE expense_id = #{expenseId} AND payment_status = 'APPROVED'
mapper.select: SELECT s.user_card_id, cd.card_name, s.prev_performance_amount, s.current_performance_amount, s.shared_limit_used FROM user_card_monthly_state s JOIN user_card uc ON uc.user_card_id = s.user_card_id JOIN card cd ON cd.card_id = uc.card_id WHERE s.user_card_id = #{userCardId} AND s.base_year_month = #{baseYearMonth}

SELECT u.user_card_id, u.benefit_id, u.used_amount, u.used_count, u.last_applied_date, u.daily_used_amount, u.daily_used_count FROM user_benefit_usage u WHERE u.user_card_id = #{userCardId} AND u.base_year_month = #{baseYearMonth}

SELECT u.user_card_id, u.benefit_id, SUM(u.used_amount) AS used_amount, SUM(u.used_count) AS used_count FROM user_benefit_usage u WHERE u.user_card_id = #{userCardId} AND u.base_year_month BETWEEN #{fromYearMonth} AND #{toYearMonth} GROUP BY u.user_card_id, u.benefit_id
mapper.update: INSERT INTO user_card_monthly_state (user_card_id, base_year_month, prev_performance_amount, current_performance_amount, shared_limit_used) VALUES (#{userCardId}, #{baseYearMonth}, #{prevPerformanceAmount}, #{performanceDelta}, #{sharedLimitDelta}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE current_performance_amount = current_performance_amount + #{performanceDelta}, shared_limit_used = shared_limit_used + #{sharedLimitDelta}

INSERT INTO user_benefit_usage (user_card_id, benefit_id, base_year_month, used_amount, used_count, last_applied_date, daily_used_count, daily_used_amount) VALUES (#{userCardId}, #{benefitId}, #{baseYearMonth}, #{discount}, 1, #{appliedDate}, 1, #{discount}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE used_amount = used_amount + #{discount}, used_count = used_count + 1, daily_used_count = IF(last_applied_date = #{appliedDate}, daily_used_count + 1, 1), daily_used_amount = IF(last_applied_date = #{appliedDate}, daily_used_amount + #{discount}, #{discount}), last_applied_date = #{appliedDate}
